title: Theo and the Contact
author: M. M. Eriksen
blurb: Felix Dunmore, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
